answer: In this economy, every identity faces random peer audit. A newcomer enters the atlas by staking 40 units for 20 epochs, a pigment mark that will not fade. Each epoch a beacon picks 5 auditors to check its work and behavior fingerprint. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 units; one honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its reward whole. Lying auditors lose their stake; the whisper network freezes any identity failing twice pending re-audit.
